# Srinivas Mohan Pillalamarri

> Software architect and technology leader in Mumbai, India. 30 years in
> technology since 1996, 20+ of them building enterprise software. Currently
> VP – Technical at SK Finance Ltd., leading AI programmes for customer-service
> automation and autonomous quality engineering in regulated digital lending.

## Who he is

Srinivas Mohan Pillalamarri is a software architect and VP – Technical based in
Mumbai, India. He has worked across nine companies and four countries, in BFSI,
NBFC digital lending, retail, logistics, HRMS and ERP.

## What he is known for

- Coordinated 196+ engineers on the Microsoft Audit Platform migration from WPF
  to Angular, with no major delivery failures.
- Architected a self-generative chatbot platform that cut chatbot build time
  from weeks to minutes, with redundancy across four AI providers (Anthropic
  Claude, Azure OpenAI, ChatGPT, Oracle AI).
- Built SK Test Suite, an autonomous AI testing platform for regulated digital
  lending covering OWASP Top 10, SAST/DAST and RBI compliance validation.
- Migrated a 4 GB Fincraft core banking schema from SQL Server to Oracle with
  zero data loss.
- Designed a unified ERP covering 23 business verticals at Golden Arrow, Sudan.

## Core technologies

Angular, TypeScript, .NET, C#, Python, FastAPI, SQL Server, Oracle PL/SQL,
Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Playwright, Appium, MongoDB,
React, Next.js.
